name: account-stats
description: Local-first daily and weekly statistics with response-speed detection, Fast API equivalents and a localized sidebar.

node_path.title: Node.js executable
node_path.description: Node.js 20 or newer. Leave as node for automatic discovery; an absolute path also works.

time_zone.title: Time zone
time_zone.description: IANA time zone for calendar days, including daylight saving. For example Europe/Lisbon or UTC.

extra_roots.title: Additional transcript directories
extra_roots.description: Optional absolute directories containing Claude Code JSONL transcripts. One path per line. Default Claude directories are discovered automatically.

include_subagents.title: Include subagents
include_subagents.description: Include recorded subagent requests in daily and model totals.

auto_open.title: Open sidebar on session start
auto_open.description: Open without taking keyboard focus. Otherwise use /account-stats.

reset_day.title: Weekly quota reset day
reset_day.description: Day of week, Sunday=0 through Saturday=6. Default: Thursday (4). Can also be changed in the sidebar.

reset_time.title: Weekly quota reset time
reset_time.description: 24-hour HH:mm in the configured IANA time zone. Default: 20:00. Re-groups local history; does not change account limits.
